title: More Coal+
description: adds coal ingots nuggets and a Coal+iron pickaxe
body:
## adds:
- recipes
- coal ingot
- coal nuggets
- coal iron pickaxe (when right click creates fire)
- coal ore recipe
- and i will add more+...

## Recipes:
- 4x coal = coal ingot
- 1x coal ingot = 9x coal nugget (shapeless)
- 2x coal ingot = coal block (shapeless)
- 1x coal ingot 1x flint 1x iron 2x sticks = coal iron pickaxe
                  +
